messages:
jess: ping — Nimbus SCIM on-host failing since 03:12 UTC, provisioning returning 401/403 intermittently.
aj: saw alert — can you paste logs?
jess: here's the API proxy trace:
```json
{"status":401,"err":"KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR","request_id":"r-9a3f"}
```
sec-bot: [alert] scim.provision.failure count=18 service=nimbus-team region=eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
olga: KMS rotate happened last night. Did we update alias mapping in private control plane? :thinking:
samir: also seeing SAML NameID casing mismatch in assertions for Nimbus SSO — could be upstream idp change.
jess: digging — the 401 seems tied to decrypt on /provision endpoint, 403 only when NameID missing.
leo: quick repro: curl to staging with header:
```bash
curl -H "x-nimbus-tenant: nimbus-prod" \
  -H "x-kms-alias: alias/redwood-nimbus" \
  https://scim.redwood.internal/v2/Users
```
jess: when alias is old name `alias/redwood` decrypt fails. After alias swap to `alias/redwood-nimbus` works.
aj: does private CP read alias from tenant config store? If so, maybe replication lag to EU cluster.
olga: yes — config propagation to eu-west had stuck job: /ops/config-propagator backoff loop. I've kicked a manual sync.
samir: also added a fallback to try previous alias names for 2min while we roll.
sec-bot: deploybot: rollout started — patch/propagator-retry scheduled to eu-west-1.
jess: quick mitigation: we added a middleware to accept either alias in header and attempt rewrap once before failing. Patch link: https://git.redwood/srv/scim/+/PR-482
leo: after manual sync, provisioning resumed for Nimbus, ~60 users onboarded in 10min :thumbsup:
aj: follow-ups: add audit log entry when alias mismatch triggers decrypt fallback, and alert when propagation delayed >30s.
olga: filing issue for oncall runbook + add tests for alias rotation across regions.
jess: cool — closing loop, will post postmortem if any residuals.
